notes.title: 30% OFF + Big Spring Update & Easter Event! 🐣
notes.content:
Hey Storage Hunters!

We’ve got two big reasons to celebrate:
[b]Storage Hunter Simulator is 30% OFF[/b] for a limited time AND we just dropped our [b]Big Spring Update[/b]! 

[h3][b]Double the Deals – Bundle with Barn Finders![/b][/h3]
We’ve got a special treat for all treasure hunters out there!
Check out our bundle featuring Storage Hunter Simulator & Barn Finders. It’s the perfect time to dive into both worlds of quirky auctions, dusty gems, and unexpected discoveries.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46058/Barn_Finders_x_Storage_Hunter_Simulator__Auction_Master/

[h3][b]Hop into the Easter Event![/b][/h3]
For a limited time, grab your basket and join the hunt! [b]Hidden Easter eggs are scattered all over the map[/b]—find them to unlock special seasonal outfits. 

Over [b]20 new Easter-themed goodies await in storage units[/b], along with 3 festive achievements to show off your having an egg-cellent time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/6ecdabffc78e3cac7c25e68b8a8311705f342f8f.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Tools & Features![/b][/h3]
You asked, we listened:
[list]
[*] The [b]lockpick tool[/b] is finally here—time to crack open those sealed containers!
[*] Introducing the [b]Item Glossary[/b], where you can track all the treasures you've found. (Note: it doesn’t backtrack, so it’ll start empty on existing saves!)
[*] Added [b]clickable map icons[/b] for easier navigation and access to info.
[*] You can now [b]verify and fix items directly inside your warehouse[/b]—no more hauling them out first!
[*] Oh, and you can now [b]place furniture in your backyard[/b]. Backyard glow-up, anyone?
[*] And there’s a brand-new [b]storage panel in warehouses that lets you store selected items nearby[/b]—previously this was only possible from the truck!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/f69758b8b1455763487c0a81dec388b5be3e7352.png[/img]

[h3][b]Exclusive New Masks![/b][/h3]
We’ve teamed up with three awesome YouTubers to bring you exclusive in-game headgear. Say hello to the Real Civil Engineer, Raptor, and Crappa masks—ready for your next epic storage hunt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/ded2377d4733dfe83ae0b61cc3da2f5800069207.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/1a98aaa19d4098a5095be192e376e64789a7a130.png[/img]

[h3][b]Full List of Changes:[/b][/h3]
[i][b]Content[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Added a time-limited Easter Event where you search for hidden Easter eggs in exchange for unique costumes.
[*] Added over 20 Easter items and 3 Easter achievements.
[*] Added Lockpick tool, used to open closed containers.
[*] Added Glossary listing all items in the game.
[*] Added another masks of your favorite streamers.
[*] Added new npc vehicles on the road.
[/list]

[i][b]Quality of Life[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Most icons on the map are now clickable, opening a panel showing useful information.
[*] Once verified items remain verified when found again ( its not working on items that were already verified before patch )
[*] Furniture can now also be placed in the backyard.
[*] Items can be verified and fix inside the warehouse without having to take them out.
[*] Added new panel to warehouses that allows you to store selected items nearby ( previously was only from truck )
[*] Audio and visualization
[*] Added several new vehicle models driving on roads.
[*] Added Easter decorations in the village and town
[/list]

[i][b]Bug fixes[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed graphical bugs with map icons.
[*] The quality of collectors statuettes is always Perfect now
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed furniture to be duplicated
[*] After changing the input in the settings, the tutorial displays the changed keys.
[*] Fixed bug where pad inputs does not appear in the tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the laptop window from closing in the pawnshop.
[*] Improved controller controls.
[*] Fixed bug where Hobby & Toys items stop being displayed in the Expert's Select Item menu after a save/load
[*] Fixed issue where pawn shop billboard has incorrect LOD
[*] Fixed bug where car inputs stop working if a new day starts when the Tablet is opened in a vehicle
[*] Fixed bug where it was possible to copy Items in the Architect Mode
[*] Fixed bug where the x button doesn't work properly in the collectors UI map
[*] Fixed bug where items in Warehouses may lose Rarity and get multiplied
[*] Fixed many translation bugs.
[*] Improved some UI elements.
[*] Fixed some audio bugs.
[/list]

Cheers,
The Storage Hunter Team

notes.title: Big Update: Collectors and Customization Are Here! Storage Hunter Now 25% Off!
notes.content:
Hello Storage Hunters!

We're back with an update you've been eagerly waiting for - [b]Collectors and Character Customization![/b] To celebrate the release of this update, [b]Storage Hunter Simulator is now available at 25% off for a limited time![/b]

[previewyoutube=a3sI7BrVjm0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Collectors NPCs[/b][/h3]
They’re finally here — [b]Collectors![/b] These special NPCs are always on the hunt for items to complete their prized collections. Help them track down the treasures on their wishlists, and as you gain their favor, they’ll reward you with exclusive prizes like unique outfits or valuable collector statuettes tied to their interests.

The number of items that can be delivered in a given week is limited, but it is reset every week. So remember to check every Monday what the collectors are looking for this time. <3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/b1499387cf00235133680104924989b6b3d7fa47.png[/img]

[h3][b]Character Customization[/b][/h3]
Make your character truly your own! With our brand-new [b]customization system[/b], you can create and refine your unique look both when starting a new game and during ongoing play.

Modify every element of your character at any time, including their facial appearance, hairstyle, hair and eye colour by approaching one of the mirrors located in the bathroom of each house in the game. The newly added [b]clothing store[/b] always allows you to buy new outfits for your character and dress them as you like, adding another layer of customisation for players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/649df67773bd8b0cec434dced52cedf55b19f2cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/0bb18154751a578599e1d97322456cd233f1de31.png[/img]

[h3][b]Performance Improvements[/b][/h3]
We’ve heard your feedback and worked hard to resolve some of the major crashes and errors you’ve reported. This update includes improvements aimed at enhancing overall game stability and performance.

[i]Still having issues?[/i]
If you experience any technical problems after the update, don’t hesitate to reach out to us via LiveChat or our Discord  — we’re here to help!

Remember to share your ideas with us! As Storage Hunter is still in Early Access, we are going to develop it along the way and based on your feedback.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm — your feedback keeps us motivated to make Storage Hunter Simulator even better.

Cheers,
The Storage Hunter Team

notes.title: Tool Disappearance Fix and Performance Issues
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We sincerely apologize for the recent inconvenience with tools disappearing. 

[b]This issue has been permanently resolved for all current and new players. However, our solution may not recover progress for everyone[/b]. So please check if your tools have reappeared and if not follow instructions below. 

[b]VERY IMPORTANT: To ensure that you recover your tools, start the game from LOAD GAME not through the button continue!!! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/00523e48cf6a73d357101a50789712257ef0cdf8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/e611d5fe062e67367d9cc7af1a83639f8319819b.png[/img]

[b]If you did not recover your tools in the newest update[/b] - to ensure the best possible experience for everyone, we are offering assistance to anyone who has lost tool levels due to this bug.


Please follow the steps below to get your progress restored:

1. [url=https://discord.com/invite/beardedbrothers]Join our Discord[/url] and click open-ticket
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/cc8e87a492ba56a3bfca6bcb8eb943dd4ec07c02.png[/img]
2. Let us know which tools levels you have lost.
3. Send us your save file.

To find your save files:

1. Type in windows explorer: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\StorageHunter\
2. Pack entire SAVED folder into a Zip/Rar

OR

1. Using Run Command Press Win + R to open the Run dialog.
2. Type: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\StorageHunter\ and hit Enter.
3. Pack entire SAVED folder into a Zip/Rar

Once you’ve submitted the necessary information, we’ll work on resolving the issue for you ASAP.

[h3]Performance Drop After Last Update[/h3]
Some users have reported performance drops after the recent update. If you're experiencing this, we recommend the following steps to improve performance:
[list]
[*] Verify game files on Steam. (You can follow this [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hpc0neyiMGc]instruction[/url]). 
[*] Enable DLSS or FSR for optimized frame rates.
[*] Consider disabling frame generation or ray tracing. [b]IT’S IMPORTANT ON 30x and 40x Geforce graphic cards; those features are not working properly right now.[/b]
[*] Limit FPS to 30/60, depending on your processor's capabilities.
[/list]
We’ve made adjustments to the default settings as they generated the errors as well. If you notice FPS drops or visual glitches, try changing one of the graphics settings and then reverting back to your original choice—it may help stabilize performance.

All the best,
Storage Hunter Team

notes.title: Fixes and Troubleshooting
notes.content:
Hey, Storage Hunters!

First, we want to thank you for your patience as we work to fix the bugs some players are experiencing. 

[b]The majority of players are enjoying smooth gameplay, but for those encountering issues, we’ve been working non-stop since launch to resolve them. Remember, this is Early Access, and your feedback is crucial![/b] If you run into problems, [url=https://discord.gg/beardedbrothers]please report them to us on Discord[/url]—we’re discussing cases and fixing bugs almost around the clock.

Now, here’s what’s happening:

[h1]Tool App Issue[/h1]
If yesterday’s hotfix didn’t resolve the issue with verification tools being stuck at level 0, there’s a workaround. Simply go to sleep in your starter home—the trailer. This was part of a fix for saves, and while it may cause problems for some existing saves, it shouldn’t affect new games.

[h1]Pawnshop Issues[/h1]
We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear! The ongoing issues with the pawnshop system are frustrating—we get it. Our team is working on a fix right now, and we’re aiming to have it out later today. Keep an eye on the announcements for more updates!

In the meantime, some of our community members have found that saving and loading your game helps as a temporary workaround. This might also help with other minor bugs you’re experiencing.


[h1]Car and Warehouse Issues[/h1]
Some players have reported confusion regarding cars and warehouses. We realize the interface at the start could be clearer, and that’s on us! We’re working on improving the initial guidance to make the early steps easier to understand.

Let’s clear that up:

[h2]No Car at the Start: [/h2]
In the full game, the car isn’t available immediately like it was in the demo. To unlock your car, follow the first mission steps:
[list]
[*] Open your tablet and sign up for an auction.
[*] Once you’ve signed up, you can go to your garage and pick up the car. 
[/list]
So don’t worry if it’s missing—just follow the mission flow!

[h2]Warehouse Location:[/h2]
Some players have mentioned they can’t find a warehouse. Your first warehouse is in front of your trailer from the very start of the game and next to the garage. Make sure to use it for storing all your loot!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/a585c2a9fc1f117ef6952e54cd9c7460a6da201f.png[/img]

[h1]Disappearing Items Overnight[/h1]
We’re currently working on a fix for an issue where items left in your car overnight may disappear for some players. Until we resolve this, [b]we highly recommend moving any valuable items to the warehouse before ending your day to avoid losing them.[/b]

[h1]Performance Issues[/h1]
Storage Hunter Simulator on the base level is a well-optimized game and runs smoothly on older cards and even on the Steam Deck. Crashes are generally caused by outdated drivers or specific technical configurations, and we’re working on addressing those cases.

We’ve also been investigating performance problems, and here’s what we’ve found so far:

[h2]Graphics Drivers:[/h2]
The majority of crashes and lag are caused by outdated GeForce drivers. Updating to the latest version has helped many players run the game smoothly, even on high settings. We know it’s odd that other games might run fine on older drivers, but our game requires the latest version for optimal performance.

[h3]AMD Drivers update:[/h3]
https://www.amd.com/en/support/download/drivers.html

[h3]Nvidia GeForce update:[/h3]
https://www.nvidia.com/en-gb/geforce/geforce-experience/

[b]For Nvidia you also have to make sure you have the Game Ready Drivers.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/ab57e5cc1b30765002916ae0826a4887122edac2.png[/img]

[h2]Intel Processor Issues[/h2]
We’re still looking into issues with certain Intel processors, especially from the newest generation. It seems to be affecting newer games as well. If you’re experiencing crashes with one of these processors, please send us your crash logs—it’ll help us pinpoint the issue. 

For experienced users, there’s a potential BIOS tweak [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2429640/discussions/0/4839770900413734195/]available on this thread[/url]. But proceed with caution and at your own risk!

We’re actively investigating all reported crashes, and we need your help! If you continue to experience crashes even after updating your drivers, please send your crash logs to us. This will help us identify the root cause and speed up the fix!

[h2]DLSS Crashes on Older GeForce Cards:[/h2]
If you’re using an older GeForce card, such as a 1080, 1650, 20x or similar, please do not enable DLSS. These cards don’t support the technology, and enabling it may cause crashes. We’re working on a future update to automatically disable this option for cards that don’t support DLSS.

To turn off DLSS, go to settings > graphics > Additional Options > Pick TSR 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/38c9e7e467875725b1642e7bcde5e7ddfc78bbb0.png[/img]

[h1]HOW TO SEND US YOUR SAVES WITH CRASH LOGS[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Type in windows explorer %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\StorageHunter\Saved\SaveGames
[*] Pack it into a Zip/Rar
[*] Send all save files.
[/olist]

OR

[olist]
[*] Using Run Command Press Win + R to open the Run dialog.
[*] Type %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\StorageHunter\Saved\SaveGames and hit Enter.
[*] Pack it into a Zip/Rar
[*] Send all save files.
[/olist]


You can sen them here:

support@raccoons.studio

notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a hotfix to address some of the most common issues - verification and repair tools and save files carried over from the demo.

1. Go to: C:\Users\[YourUsername]\AppData\Local\StorageHunter

Replace [YourUsername] with your actual username. The drive might differ depending on where you installed the game.

2. Delete the StorageHunter folder. [b]Warning: This will remove all your saved progress.[/b]

If you continue to experience issues after deleting the demo saves, please don't hesitate to contact us for further assistance!
